The documented investigation considered failed deployment as a possible contributing factor. The response focused on restoring service first, followed by validation of the suspected contributing factor.

title: auth-service Elevated error rate
content: The auth-service experienced memory pressure. Engineers reviewed version history and operational events while validating whether the suspected dependency was degraded. The documented investigation considered expired certificate as a possible contributing factor. After recovery, the team documented additional telemetry and safeguards to make the failure easier to isolate.

title: catalog-api Availability degradation
content: The catalog-api experienced queue backlog. Engineers checked logs for the affected endpoint, compared traffic levels with normal baselines, and inspected downstream calls. The documented investigation considered database connection saturation as a possible contributing factor. Engineers confirmed recovery through latency, error, dependency, and resource metrics before closing the investigation.
